# @gernst/bootstrap (v5-modern)

> Maintained fork of Bootstrap 5.3.8, modernized for 2026-era stacks. Drop-in replacement for
> `bootstrap@5`: byte-identical CSS, unchanged vanilla-JS API and `data-bs-*` attributes,
> but with deprecation-free Sass sources and a parallel `@use`/`@forward` module tree.
> Vanilla JS only — no jQuery required; Popper 2 via @popperjs/core.

## Install

- `bootstrap` → `npm:@gernst/bootstrap@^5.4.0` (npm alias keeps every `import "bootstrap"` /
  `@import "bootstrap"` working unchanged)

## Key facts

- JavaScript: vanilla, API identical to upstream 5.3.8; optional jQuery bridge still activates
  when `window.jQuery` exists; `bootstrap.bundle` embeds Popper 2.
- Sass: two trees shipped — `scss/` (legacy `@import`, zero-effort swap) and `scss/module/`
  (`@use`/`@forward`, recommended, identical CSS output verified by `npm run test-css-module`).
- Module tree: namespaced members (`variables.$primary`, `functions.tint-color()`,
  `mixins.media-breakpoint-up()`, `rfs.rfs()`); configure via `@use "variables" with (...)`.
- Functions that read variables (`rgba-css-var`, `color-contrast`, `escape-svg`,
  `assert-ascending`) live in the `variables` module.
- `utilities/api` accepts a `$utilities-subset` config; `mixins/grid` accepts
  `$include-column-box-sizing`.
- Version 5 only; for Bootstrap 4 (AdminLTE 3 era) see the `v4-modern` branch.
